title: First Block Story
subtitle: Find a beginning, change, and ending on one familiar block.
outcome: A 60- to 120-second vertical micro-documentary with a clear three-part story.

shotPrompts.title: Open with the whole block
shotPrompts.direction: Film a steady wide shot that shows where the story happens.
shotPrompts.hint: Hold long enough for the viewer to understand the place before anything changes.

shotPrompts.title: Choose one moving subject
shotPrompts.direction: Follow one person, animal, vehicle, shadow, or object in motion.
shotPrompts.hint: Keep the subject easy to track and avoid digital zoom.

shotPrompts.title: Cut closer to a clue
shotPrompts.direction: Film a detail that reveals texture, mood, or routine.
shotPrompts.hint: Choose something that answers what this place really feels like.

shotPrompts.title: Record the block's sound
shotPrompts.direction: Hold still and capture clean ambient sound from the block.
shotPrompts.hint: Traffic, birds, footsteps, machines, wind, or silence can bridge the edit.

shotPrompts.title: Find one small change
shotPrompts.direction: Film something that changes from the opening.
shotPrompts.hint: A person leaving, a light shifting, or a task finishing is enough.

shotPrompts.title: Show the result
shotPrompts.direction: Film what the change leaves behind.
shotPrompts.hint: Make the difference from the opening visible in one simple frame.

shotPrompts.title: End on a held image
shotPrompts.direction: Choose one calm final frame and hold it without moving.
shotPrompts.hint: Do not add a new idea; let the viewer sit with the ending.

guidance.structure: Establish the block, observe one change, then show what it leaves behind.
guidance.capture: Shoot vertically, hold shots steady, and collect one clean ambient sound clip.
guidance.assembly: Keep prompts in order and let the change and final image breathe.
guidance.export: Target 90 seconds in 9:16 and review the private local export before sharing.

title: Noir Shadow Mystery
subtitle: Turn shadows and ordinary details into an unresolved mystery.
outcome: A tense vertical mystery built from place, evidence, and one unanswered ending.

shotPrompts.title: Establish the shadow
shotPrompts.direction: Film the longest shadow you can find as an establishing shot.
shotPrompts.hint: Use strong side light and keep the source just outside the frame.

shotPrompts.title: Collect visual evidence
shotPrompts.direction: Shoot a repeating pattern like it is evidence.
shotPrompts.hint: Grids, tiles, or windows can suggest order and obsession.

shotPrompts.title: Watch the hands
shotPrompts.direction: Capture hands doing something ordinary without revealing the whole person.
shotPrompts.hint: Keys, a cup, or a nervous gesture can imply a hidden story.

shotPrompts.title: Gather ominous sound
shotPrompts.direction: Record the most ominous ambient sound nearby.
shotPrompts.hint: Traffic drone, wind, or a distant siren can carry the scene.

shotPrompts.title: Reveal the object
shotPrompts.direction: Shoot one ordinary object as if it holds a secret.
shotPrompts.hint: Move close and remove distracting context.

shotPrompts.title: Distort the truth
shotPrompts.direction: Film a reflection in glass, water, or metal.
shotPrompts.hint: A distorted double should make the earlier clues feel uncertain.

shotPrompts.title: Leave it unresolved
shotPrompts.direction: End with a slow retreat from the scene.
shotPrompts.hint: Let the camera drift backward without explaining the mystery.

guidance.structure: Open with place, build suspicion through details, and leave one question unanswered.
guidance.capture: Seek contrast, silhouettes, reflections, and isolated details.
guidance.assembly: Cut from wide to evidence to reflection; use the ambient recording as a mood bed.
guidance.export: Target 75 seconds in 9:16 and keep the ending unresolved.

title: Small Romance
subtitle: Build a tender story from light, gestures, and things that belong together.
outcome: A warm short film that moves from discovery to longing to an open final image.

shotPrompts.title: Find soft light
shotPrompts.direction: Film the softest light you can find.
shotPrompts.hint: Window light, a lamp through curtains, or late sun all work.

shotPrompts.title: Find a pair
shotPrompts.direction: Capture two things that seem to belong together.
shotPrompts.hint: Matching colors, parallel paths, or a pair of objects can imply a relationship.

shotPrompts.title: Notice tenderness
shotPrompts.direction: Film a small gesture of care, real or implied.
shotPrompts.hint: Keep faces optional and let the gesture carry the feeling.

shotPrompts.title: Record warmth
shotPrompts.direction: Record a sound that feels warm or familiar.
shotPrompts.hint: Laughter, birds, leaves, or room tone can connect the images.

shotPrompts.title: Honor a living detail
shotPrompts.direction: Film one flower, plant, animal, or person with patient attention.
shotPrompts.hint: Get close enough to notice a detail others might miss.

shotPrompts.title: Create longing
shotPrompts.direction: Film movement that feels like someone or something leaving.
shotPrompts.hint: A closing door or a figure walking away can create the turn.

shotPrompts.title: Open the ending
shotPrompts.direction: End by looking upward at sky, trees, or open space.
shotPrompts.hint: Let the final frame breathe rather than resolving everything.

guidance.structure: Move from discovery to connection, then let one departure open the ending.
guidance.capture: Use soft natural light and avoid staging gestures that feel uncomfortable.
guidance.assembly: Favor gentle cuts and keep the warm sound beneath the final images.
guidance.export: Target 90 seconds in 4:5 with comfortable holds and no rushed ending.

title: Observational Portrait
subtitle: Introduce a person through place, action, and revealing details.
outcome: A respectful horizontal portrait that shows what someone does without requiring an interview.

shotPrompts.title: Show their place
shotPrompts.direction: Film a wide view of the place connected to your subject.
shotPrompts.hint: Ask permission and show enough context to understand their world.

shotPrompts.title: Introduce the person
shotPrompts.direction: Capture your subject entering, settling, or beginning an activity.
shotPrompts.hint: A natural action is often stronger than a posed introduction.

shotPrompts.title: Watch skilled hands
shotPrompts.direction: Film the subject's hands doing something characteristic.
shotPrompts.hint: Hold steady and let the complete action happen inside the frame.

shotPrompts.title: Listen to the work
shotPrompts.direction: Record clean sound from the activity without speaking over it.
shotPrompts.hint: Move close enough for useful sound but stay out of the way.

shotPrompts.title: Find a revealing expression
shotPrompts.direction: Capture a face, posture, or pause that reveals concentration or feeling.
shotPrompts.hint: Do not force emotion; wait for an honest moment.

shotPrompts.title: Show what changed
shotPrompts.direction: Film the result of the subject's action.
shotPrompts.hint: Connect the finished detail to the work shown earlier.

shotPrompts.title: Let them leave
shotPrompts.direction: End with the subject leaving frame or returning to the wider place.
shotPrompts.hint: The last shot should return the person to their context.

guidance.structure: Introduce place and person, observe meaningful work, then reveal its result.
guidance.capture: Get consent, avoid interrupting, and prefer honest actions to posed coverage.
guidance.assembly: Alternate wide context with hands, expression, and result.
guidance.export: Target 90 seconds in 16:9 and confirm the subject is comfortable before sharing.

title: Everyday Horror
subtitle: Make an ordinary place feel wrong without showing a monster.
outcome: A restrained square horror short built from absence, interruption, and suspense.

shotPrompts.title: Keep darkness distant
shotPrompts.direction: Film the darkest corner you can find without moving closer.
shotPrompts.hint: Let the viewer search the frame for something that may not be there.

shotPrompts.title: Find what is wrong
shotPrompts.direction: Capture one object that seems out of place.
shotPrompts.hint: A single shoe, open door, or unexplained mark is enough.

shotPrompts.title: Interrupt the stillness
shotPrompts.direction: Film one sudden movement that breaks a quiet frame.
shotPrompts.hint: A bird, swinging door, or quick turn can create the scare.

shotPrompts.title: Record near silence
shotPrompts.direction: Record the quietest sound you can find.
shotPrompts.hint: Room tone makes the audience notice every interruption.

shotPrompts.title: Make the ordinary loom
shotPrompts.direction: Film an ordinary object from below.
shotPrompts.hint: A low angle can make furniture or architecture feel threatening.

shotPrompts.title: Wait in an empty path
shotPrompts.direction: Hold on a long empty corridor, hallway, or path.
shotPrompts.hint: Do not move the camera; suspense comes from waiting.

shotPrompts.title: Interrupt the ending
shotPrompts.direction: End with a sudden cut to black.
shotPrompts.hint: Cover the lens quickly so the film feels interrupted, not completed.

guidance.structure: Establish absence, introduce one wrong detail, and escalate through interruption and waiting.
guidance.capture: Prioritize safe locations and never surprise or endanger another person for a shot.
guidance.assembly: Use silence and longer holds before the single abrupt ending.
guidance.export: Target 75 seconds in 1:1 and keep graphic content out of the frame.

title: Dream Walk
subtitle: Connect color, texture, reflections, and slow movement like a dream.
outcome: A floating vertical mood film that follows visual associations instead of literal plot.

shotPrompts.title: Slow the world down
shotPrompts.direction: Film something moving as slowly as possible.
shotPrompts.hint: Water, fabric, clouds, or a careful camera drift can set the rhythm.

shotPrompts.title: Follow one strange color
shotPrompts.direction: Find a color that feels out of place and isolate it.
shotPrompts.hint: Let the color become the thread connecting later shots.

shotPrompts.title: Cross between textures
shotPrompts.direction: Capture a transition between two different textures.
shotPrompts.hint: Move from smooth to rough, wet to dry, or natural to artificial.

shotPrompts.title: Hear something distant
shotPrompts.direction: Record a sound that feels underwater, muffled, or far away.
shotPrompts.hint: Echoing footsteps or wind through a tunnel can feel dreamlike.

shotPrompts.title: Look through a layer
shotPrompts.direction: Film through glass, mesh, leaves, or another foreground layer.
shotPrompts.hint: Allow part of the image to stay soft or obscured.

shotPrompts.title: Meet your double
shotPrompts.direction: Film your shadow or reflection doing something unexpected.
shotPrompts.hint: Keep the gesture small so it feels discovered rather than performed.

shotPrompts.title: Dissolve into light
shotPrompts.direction: Point slowly toward open sky or pure light and hold.
shotPrompts.hint: Let detail disappear so the ending feels weightless.

guidance.structure: Repeat visual motifs and let each image suggest the next instead of explaining a plot.
guidance.capture: Move slowly, use foreground layers, and protect highlights from clipping when possible.
guidance.assembly: Match colors, shapes, and motion; keep the distant sound underneath the sequence.
guidance.export: Target 90 seconds in 9:16 and choose atmosphere over explanation.

title: Silent Object Story
subtitle: Give one ordinary object a beginning, problem, and final fate.
outcome: A playful silent-film short told with composition, movement, and intertitle-ready beats.

shotPrompts.title: Introduce the hero
shotPrompts.direction: Film one ordinary object alone in a clear frame.
shotPrompts.hint: Choose an object you can move safely and keep the background simple.

shotPrompts.title: Show its purpose
shotPrompts.direction: Show how the object is normally used.
shotPrompts.hint: One complete action gives the audience a baseline.

shotPrompts.title: Create an obstacle
shotPrompts.direction: Place one simple obstacle between the object and its purpose.
shotPrompts.hint: Use framing and cuts rather than unsafe movement or damage.

shotPrompts.title: Try and fail
shotPrompts.direction: Film an attempt that does not solve the obstacle.
shotPrompts.hint: A repeated angle or gesture can make the failure funny.

shotPrompts.title: Pause for a reaction
shotPrompts.direction: Shoot an extreme close-up as if the object is reacting.
shotPrompts.hint: Texture, a label, or a small movement can become an expression.

shotPrompts.title: Find the solution
shotPrompts.direction: Show one clear action that resolves or accepts the obstacle.
shotPrompts.hint: Make the change readable without dialogue.

shotPrompts.title: Take a final bow
shotPrompts.direction: End on the object in a new final position.
shotPrompts.hint: Hold the frame long enough for an intertitle or final joke.

guidance.structure: Introduce the object, interrupt its purpose, repeat one failed attempt, then resolve visually.
guidance.capture: Lock the camera when moving the object between shots and keep continuity simple.
guidance.assembly: Use clean cuts, repeated framing, and short intertitles instead of spoken explanation.
guidance.export: Target 75 seconds in 4:5 with the silent-film treatment and readable title holds.

title: Voiceover Diary
subtitle: Pair one personal observation with images from an ordinary day.
outcome: A reflective vertical diary shaped around a concise spoken thought and supporting images.

shotPrompts.title: Begin where you are
shotPrompts.direction: Film a wide view of the place connected to today's thought.
shotPrompts.hint: Choose a place you can revisit visually at the end.

shotPrompts.title: Observe a routine
shotPrompts.direction: Film one repeated action from your day.
shotPrompts.hint: Let the action complete without narrating while you record it.

shotPrompts.title: Find the telling detail
shotPrompts.direction: Capture a close detail that changes how the routine feels.
shotPrompts.hint: Look for wear, hesitation, contrast, or something newly noticed.

shotPrompts.title: Make room for a pause
shotPrompts.direction: Film a still frame with little or no action.
shotPrompts.hint: This gives the future voiceover space to turn the idea.

shotPrompts.title: Show what shifted
shotPrompts.direction: Film one image that represents what changed in your thinking.
shotPrompts.hint: It can be literal or metaphorical, but keep it visually simple.

shotPrompts.title: Notice the aftermath
shotPrompts.direction: Capture the routine or place after the shift.
shotPrompts.hint: Echo an earlier composition so the difference is visible.

shotPrompts.title: Return with new meaning
shotPrompts.direction: Return to the opening place and hold a final image.
shotPrompts.hint: Write one final voiceover sentence that changes the meaning of the opening.

guidance.structure: Start with a routine, introduce one reflection, and return to the opening with changed meaning.
guidance.capture: Record clean images first; add a short voiceover later in a quiet room.
guidance.assembly: Leave visual pauses under important sentences and keep narration shorter than the picture sequence.
guidance.export: Target 105 seconds in 9:16 and review the voiceover for private information before sharing.

title: One-Minute How-To
subtitle: Teach one useful task with clear visual steps and a visible result.
outcome: A concise instructional short that a viewer can follow without guessing what happens next.

shotPrompts.title: Show the result first
shotPrompts.direction: Film the finished result in one clear shot.
shotPrompts.hint: The viewer should immediately understand what they will learn.

shotPrompts.title: Lay out what is needed
shotPrompts.direction: Arrange and film every required tool or ingredient.
shotPrompts.hint: Keep labels visible and exclude anything that will not be used.

shotPrompts.title: Demonstrate the first action
shotPrompts.direction: Film the first essential action from an angle that shows both hands.
shotPrompts.hint: Complete the action once without rushing.

shotPrompts.title: Move to the key step
shotPrompts.direction: Film the most important or error-prone action closer.
shotPrompts.hint: Use a detail shot where the viewer needs precision.

shotPrompts.title: Show how to check
shotPrompts.direction: Film the sign that tells the viewer the step worked.
shotPrompts.hint: A texture, sound, measurement, or position can verify success.

shotPrompts.title: Complete the task
shotPrompts.direction: Film the final action that completes the task.
shotPrompts.hint: Keep continuity with the earlier hand and camera positions.

shotPrompts.title: Return to the result
shotPrompts.direction: Repeat the opening result shot and hold it.
shotPrompts.hint: The matching frame makes the promise feel fulfilled.

guidance.structure: Promise a result, show only necessary steps, verify the key step, and return to the result.
guidance.capture: Use a stable camera, consistent hand positions, and close-ups only where precision matters.
guidance.assembly: Cut dead time between steps but never hide an action the viewer must understand.
guidance.export: Target 90 seconds in 9:16 and confirm the instructions are safe and complete.

title: Before-and-After Transformation
subtitle: Make a small transformation satisfying by showing process and proof.
outcome: A rhythmic vertical short that clearly compares a starting state, the work, and the result.

shotPrompts.title: Record the before
shotPrompts.direction: Film the full starting state from a fixed position.
shotPrompts.hint: Mark where the phone and subject are so the final shot can match.

shotPrompts.title: Prove the starting condition
shotPrompts.direction: Capture one close detail that makes the need for change visible.
shotPrompts.hint: Choose the detail the final result will improve most clearly.

shotPrompts.title: Begin the process
shotPrompts.direction: Film the first committed action of the transformation.
shotPrompts.hint: Use a clear angle and let the action finish inside the shot.

shotPrompts.title: Build a rhythm
shotPrompts.direction: Capture two or three repeatable actions from consistent angles.
shotPrompts.hint: Similar movements will cut together into a satisfying sequence.

shotPrompts.title: Show the turning point
shotPrompts.direction: Film the moment the result first becomes recognizable.
shotPrompts.hint: Let this shot run slightly longer than the earlier process shots.

shotPrompts.title: Prove the difference
shotPrompts.direction: Match the earlier detail shot with the transformed result.
shotPrompts.hint: Keep framing and scale as close to the before shot as possible.

shotPrompts.title: Match the final wide
shotPrompts.direction: Return to the exact opening position and film the full result.
shotPrompts.hint: Hold the matched frame so the viewer can compare before and after.

guidance.structure: Establish the starting state, compress the work into clear beats, and prove the result with matched shots.
guidance.capture: Lock or mark the camera position for before-and-after comparisons.
guidance.assembly: Use rhythmic process cuts, then slow down for the proof and final wide shot.
guidance.export: Target 90 seconds in 9:16 and avoid claims the images do not honestly support.
